SELECT p1.product_id, p1.change_date, p1.price AS current_price, p2.price AS previous_price, p1.price - p2.price AS price_diff
FROM price_history p1
JOIN price_history p2 ON p1.product_id = p2.product_id
  AND p2.change_date = (SELECT MAX(change_date) FROM price_history WHERE product_id = p1.product_id AND change_date < p1.change_date)
ORDER BY p1.product_id, p1.change_date;
